name: Rogue Master
summary: Adversaries may setup a rogue master to leverage control server functions to communicate with outstations. A rogue master can be used to send legitimate control messages to other control system devices, affecting processes in unintended ways. It may also be used to disrupt network communications by capturing and receiving the network traffic meant for the actual master. Impersonating a master may also allow an adversary to avoid detection. In…

analytics.name: Analytic 1924
analytics.guidance: Real-time monitoring identifies Industrial Control System (ICS) master-role command traffic originating from a source not in the approved control server inventory, directed at multiple field devices in a pattern consistent with control-server behavior. Documented in Maroochy Water Services (falsified PDS/station addresses to impersonate the master) and the 2017 Dallas Siren incident (rogue radio transmitter to 156 sirens). OT operational-fidelity gate: Alert only when the master/station identity or source is not authorized for the target device and command function, or when a normally authorized master violates its configured role/sequence and produces a corroborating device/process-state…

analytics.name: Analytic 2151
analytics.guidance: Real-time monitoring identifies a Linux process opening Industrial Control System (ICS) protocol master connections to multiple field device Internet Protocol (IP) addresses, from a host that is not the authorized Supervisory Control and Data Acquisition (SCADA) server. OT operational-fidelity gate: Alert only when the master/station identity or source is not authorized for the target device and command function, or when a normally authorized master violates its configured role/sequence and produces a corroborating device/process-state change. Suppress legitimate redundancy/failover, hot-standby promotion, commissioning, and approved engineering master activity.

analytics.name: Analytic 2178
analytics.guidance: Real-time monitoring identifies a new device appearing on the Industrial Control System (ICS) network with network behavior consistent with an ICS master station, with a Media Access Control (MAC) address not in the approved device inventory. OT operational-fidelity gate: Alert only when the master/station identity or source is not authorized for the target device and command function, or when a normally authorized master violates its configured role/sequence and produces a corroborating device/process-state change. Suppress legitimate redundancy/failover, hot-standby promotion, commissioning, and approved engineering master activity.

analytics.name: Analytic 2278
analytics.guidance: Real-time monitoring identifies Industrial Control System (ICS) protocol master-role traffic originating from a Windows host that is not the authorized Supervisory Control and Data Acquisition (SCADA) or Distributed Control System (DCS) server. OT operational-fidelity gate: Alert only when the master/station identity or source is not authorized for the target device and command function, or when a normally authorized master violates its configured role/sequence and produces a corroborating device/process-state change. Suppress legitimate redundancy/failover, hot-standby promotion, commissioning, and approved engineering master activity.
